query:
SELECT tr_type, tr_description
                     FROM transaction_types
                    WHERE rpad(tr_type, 2) COLLATE "C" < rpad($1::text, 2)
                      AND ($2::text IS NULL OR tr_description LIKE $2::text ESCAPE '')
                    ORDER BY rpad(tr_type, 2) COLLATE "C" DESC
                    LIMIT $3
